about.title: About Us
about.description: The Spirit of Arts & Culture Association (AMYCC) is a nonprofit association based in Morocco, founded in 2026, dedicated to promoting arts, culture, and youth empowerment.

home.intro_title: Nurturing Creativity, Inspiring Youth, Serving Communities
home.intro_p1: The Spirit of Arts & Culture Association (AMYCC) is a Moroccan nonprofit association founded in 2026. We are dedicated to fostering cultural vitality, performing arts, musical heritage, and civic engagement among young people across Moroccan cities.
home.areas_subtitle: A multifaceted cultural approach designed to unlock creative potential and build inclusive communities.
home.youth_desc: Empowering young Moroccans through hands-on volunteering, artistic project management, and cultural community service.
home.partners_desc: AMYCC actively builds national and international partnerships with cultural institutions, educational centers, public bodies, and civil society organizations.
home.cta_title: Be Part of Morocco's Cultural Future
home.cta_desc: Join as an active member, volunteer in community initiatives, or collaborate as an institutional partner.

areas.arts_desc: Visual arts, painting, photography, and creative workshops celebrating artistic innovation.
areas.music_desc: Traditional Moroccan musical heritage, contemporary composition, and instrumental mastery.
areas.theatre_desc: Dramatic expression, storytelling, stage acting, and spoken-word performances.
areas.culture_desc: Preserving and celebrating Moroccan cultural diversity, folklore, and historical identity.
areas.youth_desc: Skill development, creative leadership, and mentorship pathways for emerging young creators.
areas.community_desc: Civic volunteering, neighborhood cultural events, and impactful social initiatives.

partners.title: Partners & Collaborators
partners.subtitle: Building meaningful institutional collaborations for cultural and youth development
partners.open_collaboration_desc: We welcome partnerships with public bodies, cultural institutes, schools, universities, and private sponsors aligned with our mission.
